Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Heat.

Bottom line: the Knicks win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.

analyst.text: The Knicks (1-2 in the Cup) can still reach the knockout round, but only by beating Miami by at least seven and getting a Philadelphia loss at Indiana, so expect them to push to the final whistle. Miami are 2-1 with a +25 differential and already hold the first wild-card spot. New York's health is the worry: OG Anunoby (calf) is day-to-day after three missed games, and Jalen Brunson was questionable with an illness on Wednesday. The motivation edge leans New York; the injury list leans Miami.
